best_idea: A per-owner room instance created on first visit, reference-counted by visitors, reclaimed at zero from a free-list pool, with a session token that rejects a menu choice made after the building changed.
decision_why: Keep lazy per-owner instances with refcount and free-list reuse, and the session token for choices; fix the owner-keyed reset, stable owner ids, validate-before-allocate, timer delete, a 32-bit version, and flag-then-release. Route any spend through the one ledger.
acceptance: A player enters a friend's house and the instance is created; the friend leaves last and a third player enters the same room; a server test asserts a menu choice made after the house layout changed is refused with the stale message, and an entry after a visitor-last exit succeeds.
